Historical full-card image of [[Uh-oh! (V) (Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire) (PC Gallery Text)|Uh-oh!]] ([[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]]). Its game text does not match the publisher slip: it has no “During your deploy phase” limit and ends “May ▼ one Clak’dor VII, Neb Dulo, or a musician.” The file is byte-identical (SHA-1 64558e34e2ccfa51fdbceb610aa64e060d98dc2b) to the Players Committee's own card-gallery image, captured by the Internet Archive on 19 November 2007. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.

== Source ==
* Package: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/holotable/windows/holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe] (Story #419).
* Distribution member: <code>cards/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/uhoh.gif</code>.
* Same file on the Players Committee card gallery: [http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v7/ls/uhoh.gif swccgpc.com/cards/v7/ls/uhoh.gif]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071119090118id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v7/ls/uhoh.gif Internet Archive], captured 19 November 2007.
